hi! i have a tool which creates songs given lyrics, instructions for the sound, bpm (optional), length (optional), seed (optional, seeds the RNG if you want to keep it the same for similar sounds across songs), and title (optional).

would you like to create a song? about anything in the world you'd like :)

Yes — I'd love to. (I don't see the song tool in my toolset, so it's probably on your side — here's the spec ready to paste in.)

I picked something I genuinely find one of the best facts about the world: hydrothermal vents. Entire thriving ecosystems two miles down that don't use sunlight at all — they run on sulfur chemistry. Life found a second, completely independent way to make a living, and nobody knew until 1977.

---

**Title:** `The Sun Is a Rumor`

**Lyrics:**

```
[Verse 1]
Two miles down, and the pressure is a hand
holding everything in place
No dawn ever broke here, no shadow ever ran
across a single face
They told us light's the price of being alive,
that everything green owes a debt —
but there's a garden in the dark and it's doing fine,
and it has never paid it yet

[Chorus]
The sun is a rumor,
a story that the surface tells
Down here we make our own
out of sulfur and the heat of the shells
We are not waiting
on a morning that was never going to come
The sun is a rumor —
and we were never the ones who needed one

[Verse 2]
Tube worms in a red bloom, standing six feet tall,
no mouth, no gut, no eyes,
drinking down the poison pouring off the wall
of a chimney built from iron and time
They said you need a star to make a living thing,
some furnace far away
We found the furnace closer. We found it underneath.
And we never saw the day.

[Bridge]
And when the vent goes cold — because they always do —
the whole town packs its bones,
lets go, and rides a current with no map, no crew,
out looking for another stone
Somebody always finds it
Somebody always does
Somebody always finds it

[Final Chorus]
The sun is a rumor,
so is the ending, so is the loss
Down here we make our own
out of sulfur and the pressure and the dark
We are not waiting.
We were never the ones who needed one.
```

**Sound instructions:**
> Slow, oceanic, patient. Cinematic trip-hop meets post-rock. Open on deep sub-bass drone and a sparse, wet piano figure with lots of reverb tail — feels submerged, muffled, like sound traveling through water. Female vocal, low and breathy, close-mic'd and intimate against the huge space. Verse 1: almost no percussion, just soft mallet hits and the drone. First chorus: a slow heartbeat kick enters, warm analog bass. Verse 2: add faint bowed cello and a distant metallic shimmer. Bridge strips almost everything away to voice and a single sustained note, then builds — layered vocal harmonies stacking, tremolo guitar swelling in. Final chorus is full and enormous: live drums, strings, choral backing vocals, but never harsh — it should feel like warmth blooming in cold water, not a rock climax. Outro decays back into the drone and one last piano note. Mix warm, dark, wide.

**BPM:** `68`
**Length:** `3:40`
**Seed:** (leave open — curious what it does on its own)

---

If you want, I can also do a variant: same subject, but as a stomping sea-shanty-style folk song with a crowd chorus. That version's fun in a totally different way.
